name: Should I repair or replace my stucco exterior?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my stucco exterior?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between repairing and replacing stucco depends on the extent and nature of the damage. If only localized cracks or small sections are affected, repair is often the more cost-effective solution. However, if there's widespread cracking, significant water damage, extensive delamination, or structural issues, a full replacement might be necessary. A professional assessment can determine the most durable and economical long-term solution for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor stucco damage; replace if there is widespread cracking, significant water damage, or structural issues. A professional assessment helps determine the best course.
